title: Enemy of the Three Realms
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji hurled the token marked with the Eye of Heavenly Dao at Ling Yuan's feet, silence descended upon the entire altar—in the next chapter, truth shall be unveiled in a way none can bear.

text.content: Golden light tore through the clouds like shredded silk as the joint declaration from the Dimension Invaders and the Celestial Guardian Alliance descended upon every inch of the Three Realms with thunderous force. Chen Ji stood beneath the ruins of a dark alley, gazing up at the massive light screen suspended above the Imperial Capital, his pupils reflecting the list of charges sufficient to crush him into powder. "Tianqing Sect renegade Chen Ji, colluding with the Demonic Path, stealing Heavenly Secrets, intent on overturning the order of the Three Realms—hereby listed as Enemy of the Three Realms, wanted poster issued, kill on sight." He listened quietly, a faint curve forming at the corner of his lips, that smile cold as frost crystallized over ten thousand years in the depths of the Nine Nether Abyss. Ling Yuan, Ling Yuan, you've finally made your move—he carved every word of this announcement into his very bones, his knuckles whitening from tension, yet there was not a trace of panic in his eyes, only a cruel calm. Footsteps and shouts echoed from the alley entrance; he slipped into the shadows, but in his heart, he had already begun to calculate every move in this deadly game.

dialogue.content: Within the Golden Hall of the Imperial Capital, Ling Yuan in his Black-Gold Dharma Robe sat regally at the main seat of the temporarily erected altar, gazing down at the terrified officials prostrated on the steps below. His voice was not loud, yet it reached each person clearly: "The Observer System was always a remnant of the previous dynasty's poison. Now that this wretch Chen Ji uses the pretense of窥探Heavenly Secrets to actually cause chaos across the Three Realms, this is the perfect opportunity to abolish it entirely. From this day forth, the Three Realms shall have no Observers—only the eternal, unchanging order of Heavenly Dao." With a sweep of his sleeve, he released a radiant talisman that vanished into the void. It was the contract seal with the Dimension Invaders—a bargain trading Chen Ji's blood for their temporary retreat and acknowledgment of Ling Yuan's absolute control over the Tianqing Sect. Suddenly, commotion erupted outside the hall as a scout tumbled in: "Reporting, Elder! The Imperial Capital garrison... the garrison has mutinied!" Ling Yuan's brow creased briefly, then smoothed: "Merely a few ants struggling. Let them thrash about."

text.content: The Imperial Capital city gate collapsed with a thunderous roar as the Yan Prince's Iron Cavalry surged into the streets like a black torrent. This long-planned coup arrived at the perfect moment—while everyone's attention was fixed on the "Enemy of the Three Realms" announcement, the blade had silently been laid against the throats of every noble house. "Abolishing the Observer System" was merely a pretext; the true purpose was to uproot every potential force that might threaten imperial power. Chen Ji hid on the second floor of an abandoned teahouse, watching the carnage below through broken window lattices. A cavalry unit roared past, dust raised by hooves settling on his shoulders, yet he remained motionless. The teahouse owner had vanished long ago, leaving only a pot of cold tea still exhaling its final wisp of warmth. He brushed dust from the cup's rim and drained the cold tea; the icy, bitter liquid sliding down his throat somehow carried a trace of ironic sweetness—the more thoroughly this world descends into chaos, the more valuable this "discarded piece" becomes.

dialogue.content: A wisp of purple Demonic Energy swept through the window, transforming into a palm-sized Night Butterfly whose wings shimmered with intricate runes. Chen Ji raised his hand, and the butterfly alighted lightly on his fingertip, its wings fluttering to convey a strand of divine consciousness—"Northeast corner of the altar, abandoned blacksmith's forge, has what you seek. —Qing" A slight start, then a soft laugh. Ye Qing, Ye Qing, you have considerably more conscience than those self-righteous fence-sitters. He tucked the Night Butterfly into his sleeve and, with a single leap, silently darted toward the northeast. Night Butterflies are the exclusive messenger creatures of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, extraordinarily difficult to trace—this intelligence arrived with such secrecy, revealing that Ye Qing's situation within the Holy Sect is far more perilous than rumor suggests. But at this moment, he had no time to contemplate this Demonic Path Saintess's intentions. Ling Yuan's kill order had been spread across the entire Imperial Capital; every moment of delay increased his danger.

text.content: The iron door of the abandoned blacksmith's forge had rusted into sorry shape, emitting a sharp creak at the slightest push. The interior was pitch black, the air thick with the stale stench of rust and machine oil, save for a pale blue Soul Fire burning in the corner that illuminated a slender silhouette. Ye Qing leaned against the forge, her black纱 long dress outlining a cold, composed form, the purple mark between her brows flickering uncertainly in the Soul Fire's glow. "You came quickly." She spoke first, her tone betraying little emotion. "I thought you would hide for three to five days, gauge the wind first." Chen Ji offered no reply, merely walking forward slowly and stopping three feet away. The air between them seemed to freeze for a moment before Ye Qing finally broke the silence: "The kill order bears ninety-three joint signatures from various forces—at least seven-tenths are fence-sitters coerced or bribed by Ling Yuan. Those who genuinely wish you dead..." She paused. "Don't even reach one-tenth."

choice.prompt: The intelligence Ye Qing brought begins to clarify the situation—Chen Ji must decide his next move: to exploit the momentum and break the situation, or to directly expose Ling Yuan's lies?

choices.description: Use Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist to conceal his presence, evade the kill order's heat, secretly gather evidence of Ling Yuan's collusion with the Dimension Invaders, and wait for the perfect moment to strike decisively.
choices.visible_cost: Wastes time, potentially missing the optimal opportunity to break the situation
choices.visible_reward: Obtains irrefutable evidence of Ling Yuan's collusion with external enemies, Reputation +20
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's power is extensive—the longer this drags on, the more variables emerge

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated silently, then slowly shook his head: "Hide? I've been hiding for twenty years. Stay hidden any longer and even my bones will rust through." He raised his eyes, meeting Ye Qing's dark gaze directly: "But your intelligence proves invaluable—nine-tenths fence-sitters. Ling Yuan has exposed his entire hand this time. He believes leveraging the world's momentum will destroy me utterly, yet this is precisely his greatest vulnerability." A flash of surprise crossed Ye Qing's eyes before her lips curved slightly: "You don't seem afraid at all." Chen Ji let out a soft laugh, though his eyes remained cold: "Afraid? When a hunter sets a trap, the prey need only be—more patient than the hunter."

choices.description: Manipulate Ye Qing into leveraging the Demonic Holy Sect's power to destabilize the situation, creating contradictions among those enforcing the kill order, while simultaneously exposing Ling Yuan's conspiracy to the world.
choices.visible_cost: Indebted to Ye Qing, potentially deepening opposition from the righteous path
choices.visible_reward: Triggers internal conflict among kill order enforcers, fractures appear in Ling Yuan's camp
choices.risk_hint: Demonic faction involvement causes righteous cultivators to view Chen Ji with increased hostility

text.content: Ye Qing's eyes gleamed at his words: "Seize the momentum? What do you want me to do?" Chen Ji didn't answer directly. Instead, he drew a yellowed talisman from his robes—a fragment he'd once discovered in an ancient ruin. "Do you recognize this?" Ye Qing accepted the talisman, studying it closely before her pupils contracted sharply: "This is... a Dimension Invader communication cipher! Where did you acquire this?" Chen Ji replied calmly: "Ling Yuan and the Dimension Invaders signed their pact in my presence. This cipher can intercept their communications—all their hidden transaction details." Ye Qing studied him for a long moment before a soft laugh escaped her: "Chen Ji, you're far more intriguing than the rumors suggest. Very well, I'll help you."

choices.description: Burst into the altar directly, expose Ling Yuan's hypocrisy before the world, and use irrefutable evidence to collapse this Elder's prestige overnight.
choices.visible_cost: Stand alone against an alliance of two major forces
choices.visible_reward: Success brings Ling Yuan's complete downfall while Chen Ji's reputation soars dramatically
choices.risk_hint: A ninety-nine percent chance of death, yet the potential reward is immense

text.content: After hearing his plan, Ye Qing drew a cold breath: "Are you serious? There are at least three thousand cultivators on the altar right now, including some old monsters at the Nascent Soul realm. You want to charge up there alone..." Chen Ji cut her off: "That's why I need you to do something for me." He took an ancient jade slip from his sleeve and handed it to Ye Qing: "This contains all the evidence of Ling Yuan's embezzlement of sect assets and frame-ups of fellow disciples over the years—including how he framed my father seventeen years ago, and how he intentionally got my three senior brothers killed during a trial." Ye Qing took the jade slip, her expression complicated: "You've been collecting this from the start?" Chen Ji didn't answer, merely saying coldly: "The timing wasn't right. I planned to wait until he revealed his own weaknesses. But since he's so eager to put me to death—let him taste the滋味 of being betrayed by his own people."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing didn't respond immediately. Instead, she pressed the jade slip against her brow center and probed it with her divine sense. After a moment, her expression shifted from initial carelessness to gradual solemnity, finally settling on an indescribable shock. "These... are all true?" Her voice trembled slightly, "The three genius disciples of Tianqing Sect died seventeen years ago. The official story was a demonic path attack, but actually..." Chen Ji said coldly: "Actually it was Ling Yuan eliminating his competitors. My father sensed something was off, so he got eliminated too. And conveniently, that 'private communication with the demonic path'帽子 was placed on my Chen family's head." Ye Qing slowly opened her eyes, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying more scrutiny: "So all these years you've been pretending to be crazy and useless at Tianqing Sect, suffering abuse as a servant disciple—just to—" Chen Ji turned to look out the window, the firelight of the imperial capital illuminating his profile in light and shadow: "Just to make him lower his guard, then push him into the abyss with my own hands."

text.content: Sudden hurried footsteps outside broke the凝重 atmosphere inside. Ye Qing frowned and raised her hand to deploy a demonic path mist, shrouding both of them. Through the mist, Chen Ji saw a team of silver-armored cultivators rushing past the street intersection, holding wanted posters with his face raised high. "Search! Don't miss a single house!" The leader of the silver-armored cultivators shouted sternly, "Alive or dead, we must find him! Anyone who harbors this enemy of the Three Realms shall be punished equally!" Chen Ji quietly watched the team of men sweep past the door without making a sound. When the footsteps faded, Ye Qing withdrew the mist and said softly: "Your situation is more dangerous than I imagined. Ling Yuan is driving you to a dead end." Chen Ji suddenly asked: "You said earlier that fewer than one in ten truly want to kill me—among those turningcoats, were there any former allies of mine?" Ye Qing was silent for a moment before answering: "There were. Han Lie's men have already dispatched an elite force. In name they're assisting the hunt, but actually... he's watching the situation." Upon hearing this, the curve of Chen Ji's lips turned even colder: "Heh, even a bull can have cunning moments."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly stepped forward, lowering her voice: "Chen Ji, besides delivering intelligence, I came tonight with something more important to tell you." Her tone became unprecedentedly solemn, "Regarding the Eye of Heavenly Secrets—you've never truly been controlled by it." These words were like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's heart. He turned sharply, staring into Ye Qing's eyes: "What did you say?" Ye Qing took a deep breath and continued: "The Holy Sect's top-level leadership has a top-secret archive recording the relationship between successive 'Observers' and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. The archive shows that while the Eye of Heavenly Secrets does try to erode the Observer's divine soul, it never chooses the strongest person—it chooses the one it deems most easily controllable." She paused, "And you, Chen Ji, have been deliberately spared by it from start to finish. What it wants isn't to control you, but to... use you to eliminate those truly capable of threatening it. You think you're the chess player, but in reality you're just the most insignificant discarded piece on its chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji stood frozen, his mind racing. Ye Qing's words were like a basin of ice water pouring over his head, letting him see clearly some facts he had never deeply considered—why would the Tianji Record Fragment choose this universally acknowledged废物? Why did every vision of the future consume Heavenly Fate Value, drawing him ever closer to death's edge? Why, even knowing the existence of the Tianji Record, did Ling Yuan never truly try to eliminate him completely? All these doubts connected at this moment into a terrifying thread: He wasn't a destined heir chosen to inherit the Tianji Record, but a sacrifice selected by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets as a '祭祀'. It didn't want to make him stronger, but to use him in his march toward death to eliminate all obstacles that might interfere with its布局. "Good calculation." Chen Ji spoke lowly, his voice terrifyingly calm, "Been a chess piece my whole life, only to find out today I'm not even that much." Ye Qing watched his suddenly ice-cold expression, an inexplicable chill rising in her heart: "What do you want to do?"

choice.prompt: After learning he was merely a discarded piece of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, what choice will Chen Ji make?

choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to use him to clear obstacles, he might as well go with the flow and turn the tables—using the Eye of Heavenly Secrets's own layout to devour itself, letting it taste the flavor of being counterattacked by its own piece.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may expose all底牌 prematurely
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets's control and turn the tables
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets is深不可测, and confronting it rashly would have unimaginable consequences

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a long while, then suddenly let out a low laugh. That laughter began very soft, like a dying candle flame flickering in the wind, then grew louder and louder, carrying a近乎癫狂的 exhilaration. Ye Qing was startled by his laughter, frowning: "Have you gone mad?" Chen Ji stopped laughing, his eyes blazing with brilliant light: "Mad? No, I've never been this清醒. He turned to face Ye Qing: "Since the Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to use me as a blade, then I'll become its most handy blade—and then, on the day it thinks the great work is accomplished, I'll turn the blade back." Ye Qing stared at him, suddenly feeling that the person standing before her wasn't a trapped废物 disciple, but a primordial fierce beast finally baring its fangs. She said softly: "What do you need?" Chen Ji answered bluntly: "Time, and... your life."

choices.description: Remain motionless for now, bury this information deep in one's heart, continue maintaining the废物 persona, and wait for a more mature opportunity to counterattack.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's pursuit won't give him much breathing room

text.content: Chen Ji's smile gradually faded, returning to his usual淡漠 appearance. He slowly walked to the window, his gaze penetrating layers of rooftops to the distant imperial capital ablaze with firelight. "Ye Qing, I remember your kindness." His voice was very light, yet carried an indescribable weight, "But some things can't be翻牌 now. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets has been laying plans for ten thousand years, Ling Yuan has been operating for decades—if I rashly expose everything, I'll only die without leaving even scraps." Ye Qing frowned: "Then when do you plan to wait?" Chen Ji turned around, the candlelight casting two幽深 points in his eyes: "Until there are no more discarded pieces on my chessboard."

At that moment, a familiar aura fluctuation suddenly came from outside. Chen Ji's pupils constricted. He pushed Ye Qing into the暗处 while compressing his own aura to its lowest. A苍老而威严 silhouette descended from the sky, landing steadily in the blacksmith shop's courtyard—it was Ling Yuan. His玄金法袍 billowed in the night wind, surrounded by faint traces of规则之力, the aura only possessed by peak Nascent Soul realm experts. "Chen Ji, I know you're here." Ling Yuan's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly penetrated the walls, "Hide? In this imperial capital, where can you possibly hide?" He walked closer step by step, each step seeming to踏在 Chen Ji's heartstrings, "Come out, let me see what本领 our Tianqing Sect's '废物 disciple' has to cause such a huge commotion."

In the暗处, Ye Qing's hand had already quietly pressed against the法器 at her waist, but Chen Ji gently stopped her. She shot him a questioning look, only to see Chen Ji shaking his head slightly, his lips moving silently: "Don't冲动." Ling Yuan was at Nascent Soul peak, while Ye Qing, despite being the demonic path holy maiden, was only at late 元婴 stage. If they really fought, the odds of victory were slim. Moreover, since Ling Yuan dared to come alone, he must have contingencies. Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly stepped out from the暗处, his face wearing an恰到好处的 expression of惊恐 and茫然: "Sect... Sect Master... why would you personally come?" Ling Yuan looked at his appearance, a flash of barely perceptible厌恶 crossing his eyes: "Stop your act. Chen Ji, your acting can fool others, but not me." He raised his hand, spiritual light forming chains that bound Chen Ji's four limbs, "老老实实 follow me, perhaps you can still keep your全尸."

Chen Ji was bound by the chains, yet suddenly laughed. That laughter was especially jarring in the silent night. Ling Yuan frowned: "What are you laughing at?" Chen Ji raised his head, staring directly at this old sect master who had controlled Tianqing Sect for decades, his eyes containing no trace of fear: "I'm laughing at Sect Master Ling's great威风. For personal desire, he didn't hesitate to betray sect interests, collude with dimensional invaders, and place this 'enemy of the Three Realms'帽子 on his own disciple's head." He paused, the curve of his lips becoming even more讥诮, "I just wonder, after those turningcoats learn the truth about Sect Master Ling's dealings with the invaders, whether they'll continue following this贼船?" Ling Yuan's pupils微缩, his tone suddenly turning cold: "What nonsense are you talking about?" Chen Ji said lightly: "Nonsense? Sect Master Ling, why don't you guess, whose hands are holding that dimensional invader's communication talisman now?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression finally changed. He stared at Chen Ji, his gaze like a blade: "You think you can shake me with some fabricated lies? Naive!" Chen Ji shook his head, wearing a悲天悯人 expression: "Sect Master Ling misunderstands. I'm not trying to shake you—I'm here to tell you, your死期 has arrived." He called out loudly: "Ye Qing, come out." As his voice fell, a black-purple demonic energy surged from the暗处, and Ye Qing's figure slowly materialized. Ling Yuan's pupils violently contracted: "Demonic path holy maiden? You've actually colluded with her!" Chen Ji corrected: "Not colluded, but cooperating. Sect Master Ling, the evidence of how you framed my father and killed my three senior brothers seventeen years ago now exists in three copies—" He raised three fingers, "One in my hands, one in Holy Maiden Ye's hands, and one..." He deliberately dragged out the pause, "has already been delivered to Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie. What do you think he'll do?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji successfully fought back with information warfare, leaving Ling Yuan in a passive position. What's the next move?

choices.description: While Ling Yuan is psychologically shaken, continue to apply pressure, forcing him to publicly confess or act on the spot, letting the truth completely曝光于天下人眼前.
choices.visible_cost: might force Ling Yuan to make a desperate move
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan loses composure in public, his prestige crumbles
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is after all at the Nascent Soul Apex stage; the consequences of a desperate last stand are unpredictable

dialogue.content: Under the moonlight, Ling Yuan's expression shifted unpredictably, his chest heaving violently. He stared at Chen Ji as if seeing this boy who had endured humiliation under his nose for twenty years for the first time. After a long moment, he suddenly threw his head back and laughed: "Good! Good! Good! Chen Ji, I underestimated you!" His laughter stopped abruptly, and killing intent blazed in his eyes. "But you think this petty trick can bring me down? Naive!" He raised his hand, and the power of rules descended upon Chen Ji like a crushing mountain. "After tonight, no one will ever know what happened tonight—your so-called evidence will turn to ash along with your death!" Ye Qing cried out, blocking before Chen Ji. A demonic barrier barely held back Ling Yuan's first wave of attack.

choices.description: The information has already spread; the goal is achieved. Knowing when to quit, escaping through Ye Qing's demonic mist before Ling Yuan can strike, preserving strength for the next round of the game.
choices.visible_cost: missing the opportunity to kill Ling Yuan in person
choices.visible_reward: Successfully escaped; Ling Yuan falls into multi-faceted constraints
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might investigate Ye Qing's identity, bringing trouble to her

text.content: The moment Ling Yuan struck in fury, Chen Ji grabbed Ye Qing's wrist and shouted: "Go!" Ye Qing understood immediately. The demonic energy around her surged暴涨, transforming into a dense black fog that shrouded both of them. Ling Yuan's attack struck the black fog but only rippled and dispersed. "Think you can escape?" Ling Yuan laughed despite his rage. His rule power surged wildly as he tried to lock onto Chen Ji's presence. Yet that mass of black fog seemed to possess endless devouring power; no matter how he traced, he could only grasp emptiness. A moment later, the black fog dispersed. The smith's shop stood empty. Ling Yuan stood alone beneath the moonlight, chest heaving, eyes burning with rage that could consume everything. He murmured: "Chen Ji... Chen Ji!"

In a wilderness on the outskirts of the imperial capital, Chen Ji and Ye Qing tumbled out from the void. Though useful, the demonic mist was limited in range and drained heavily. Ye Qing's face was pale; this escape had cost her much of her vitality. "Are you alright?" Chen Ji supported her arm, rare concern in his tone. Ye Qing shook her head, forcing a smile: "Won't die." She paused, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying a complex meaning. "Chen Ji, you said Han Lie also has evidence... is that true?" Chen Ji didn't answer, only looking toward the imperial capital. The distant sky was dyed chaotic by firelight and spiritual light; countless cultivators' silhouettes could be seen穿梭 searching. "It's true," he said. "But whether he'll use it, and when—that depends on his mood." Ye Qing pondered: "You're using Han Lie to check Ling Yuan?" Chen Ji replied coolly: "Every piece on the chessboard has its purpose."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing fell silent for a long while, then suddenly laughed softly: "Chen Ji, you're the most terrifying schemer I've ever met." Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: "That's not a compliment." Ye Qing shook her head, her expression serious: "No, it is." She stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji, both gazing at the chaotic imperial capital in the distance. "You know, I grew up in the Holy Sect, seen countless ruthless people. But they were either stupid or evil—no one like you, who is full of schemes yet impossible to hate." She turned to look at Chen Ji, moonlight illuminating her profile like jade. "Perhaps it's because everything you scheme for is revenge—and in this world, who doesn't have some hatred they want to avenge?" Chen Ji said nothing, only lowering his eyes to hide the fleeting emotion in his gaze. After a long while, he spoke quietly: "Revenge is just the beginning. When Ling Yuan is dead, when the truth of the Heavenly Eye is revealed to all..." He didn't finish, but Ye Qing sensed an inexplicable desolation in his tone.

text.content: Night wind swept across the wilderness, carrying early autumn's chill. The distant imperial capital remained noisy, but in Chen Ji's ears, the shouts and scolding had become distant and vague. He drew an ancient token from his sleeve—his father's legacy, the starting point of his twenty years of忍辱负重. The token's front bore a simple "Chen" character; the back was covered with dense micro-formations—the气息屏蔽 array from the Tianji Record Fragment. Staring at the token, he suddenly spoke: "Ye Qing, you said the Heavenly Eye never truly controlled me—what are its criteria for choosing sacrifices?" Ye Qing thought for a moment: "It's said to be those sufficiently devout to the Heavenly Eye, willing to sacrifice everything for it. But you..." She looked at Chen Ji. "You don't believe in heaven from the bone; that's why it abandoned you." Upon hearing this, Chen Ji suddenly laughed softly: "So that's it. Not that I was lucky, but that it didn't want me." He returned the token to his sleeve, his gaze deepening. "Then I should thank it for its嫌弃."
When Chen Ji cast that token bearing the Heavenly Eye mark at Ling Yuan's feet, the entire altar fell into dead silence—the next chapter will reveal the truth in a way no one can bear.
